text_block_list.text: After school, while out in town to buy supplies for Tracen Academy, I spotted a horse girl acting suspiciously sneaky.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! S-Shh...!
The two from the "Dandelion Appreciation Club" will notice us...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look, those two over there!
They go on outings like that regularly desu.
...To search for dandelions!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Which means—if we tail those two, we'll find out what made Grass fall in love with dandelions!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I mean, aren't you curious? Grass is definitely keeping a secret from us desu!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, who knows?
I've long forgotten the reason why I came to love them.
choice_data_list: (It really does seem like she's hiding something...)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so curious I can't even sleep!
...So!! Let's solve the dandelion mystery together!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here is El's deduction desu!
Grass knows a lot about dandelion dishes, so it must have started with the taste—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, "Dandelions: A History in Herbal Medicine"!
Maybe I should buy this!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, being so nutritious is part of the dandelion's charm, after all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? That's not it desu ka...? Then she must have fallen in love because it's good for your health desu ne!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My... this pressed dandelion bookmark is lovely, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: D-Dandelion merchandise desu ka...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A dandelion... movie...?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I don't get it at all! What on earth is the reason she loves dandelions desu ka...?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But El won't give up!
If tailing doesn't work, next time I'll secretly peek into Grass's diary—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Ehhh?! So you were following behind us the whole time...? I didn't notice at all!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry desu...
But seeing you love them so much, El just felt there had to be a special reason...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, El.
...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It was the influence of my mother's older sister—my aunt.
That's how I developed an attachment to dandelions.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My aunt was a horse girl who ran in American races, and it was thanks to her that I first learned about the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: And what my aunt always made me drink was dandelion tea.

text_block_list.name: Grass's Aunt
text_block_list.text:
"This stuff is the best for your health, you know.
To tackle races with all your heart and soul—you've got to stay full of energy forever!"

text_block_list.name: Young Grass
text_block_list.text:
(...Ah, I see.
To devote oneself daily to the world of racing, the goal is—)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
To keep running forever...
And to face racing with total sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: To me, the symbol of that commitment became the lovely flower known as the dandelion.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I remember being so surprised when we bumped into each other at the dandelion tea shop! And then we talked on the way home, right?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: We said we'd keep running in races forever without losing to injuries or illnesses!
choice_data_list: And so you founded the "Dandelion Appreciation Club", huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Well now, El, what do you think? Now you can sleep at night without having to tail us, right?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh...
...Grass, is that really all desu ka?
El feels like there's another reason...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you're overthinking it, you know?
That truly is my sincere feeling.
A few days later, during a training break, I saw Grass Wonder gazing intently at El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, doing so many side-by-side sprints...
With unwavering eyes, just like a hawk...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I really can't tell you after all.
Because—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: (Because the feelings I wish to direct towards you are the very meaning of that flower's English name, "dandelion"—lion's tooth.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then... I'll do one more run too.
I can't afford to throw in the towel over just this much!
A few days later, I spotted Grass Wonder being offered some food by Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Healthy pudding made with dandelions...
How is it?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... It's delicious♪
Oh, I should pair it with my dandelion black tea—
Watching the two of them, I suddenly felt an irresistible craving to eat dandelion dishes myself.
